result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the promotional banner has poor text contrast and horizontal carousels leave content awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The white promotional text, especially “Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10,” has very low contrast against the pale mint banner and is difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use substantially darker text or a darker banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The category row shows a narrow, unidentified fragment of the next pill at the right edge, which looks accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing and viewport padding so a meaningful portion of the next option is visible, or keep partially visible items from becoming tiny slivers.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” and its restaurant name are sharply clipped by the right edge without an ellipsis or comfortable inset.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal list and apply intentional text truncation so partial cards clearly communicate horizontal scrolling without appearing broken.
